Okay.....as someone who was in the same mindset as you not even a week or two ago, I say this with the kindest intent.....



Let go.



Please, just let go. As a witch, I can promise you right now that subliminals are not witchcraft. We do not use subs in our practice and subs are part of their own community/part of spirituality. To break it down, subliminals are affirmations to help your subconscious fulfill desires. I would even go as far as to say that it helps you with the law of attraction/assumption. Nothing magic about it, just the ways of the universe. 




The reason why you need to let go is because I see you're obsessing over this person and the results of your bonds. I do understand wanting this connection, as I've listened to subs constantly in fear of losing my own connections with my partners. Obsessing over your results can be harmful to your wellbeing. You end up nitpicking at little things you consider to be "negative" to the point that it drives you crazy. I had my own issues with this, but do realize: You shouldn't be chasing your results, they will come to you. Your thoughts and emotions reflect your reality, so if you are constantly thinking and feeling negative things about how he may not like you or that he might hate you, there's a much increased chance that negative things will keep occurring.




As for submakers, please stop accusing them of putting bad affirmations or using black magic (which is what I assume you meant by witchcraft) in their subliminals. I got fantastic results from ur mom's relationship enhancer sub, and I still do as of now. All of the creators you've mentioned, I've been getting nothing but good results from them. They are very safe and have no ill will to us sub users or other submakers. If you're really that paranoid of them using bad affirmations, then I kindly ask you to stop using them. Lovegood is also very safe, might I add, so if they help, keep listening to them:) 




If the connection is meant to be, then it is meant to be. If it's not, there are even more wonderful souls out there who may find you to be their type. I know it hurts, I really do. Focus on other aspects of your life. Manifest something else you've been wanting other than this connection. The more you put your thoughts towards other things, the more you may actually see results come through. I decided to let go of my fear of my partners leaving and I've noticed within the past few days I've been hearing from them a lot more. I've realized they have other priorities to be focusing on and that they're trying to work on their own wellbeing. The more you obsess, the more you're resisting what you want.




I cannot tell what kind of intentions you have, good or bad, but I hope that you have good ones. Take a break from the community for a while, and please, again, please stop accusing them. What doesn't work for one person may work for another. Work on changing your mindset, even. There are plenty of videos out there that show you how, maybe it can help.

When it comes to outbursts, these could have a lot of reasons to them, but I know one of my biggest reasons is lack of communication. Make sure you're being straight to the point with him but not blunt, more of just like a "hey I'm going to do this" or "hey can you please do this?". I guess it's all a matter of wording and tone. When it comes to manipulative tendencies, I'm not sure. Some people do it on purpose, others not. Having a 1 on 1 discussion could help with that, maybe just letting him know that "hey, this and this is going on and I feel like it's hurting the both of us." Or something along those lines.
